Title: Pahadi Pisyu Loon (Traditional Salts)
Body (HTML):
Uttarakhand's heritage salts, hand-crushed on traditional stone (Sil-Batta) with native mountain herbs, seeds, and spices.

Adds an incredible smoky, tangy kick to any meal, salad, or raita. Sourced from the clean heights of the Himalayas, our flavored salts (Pisyu Loon) are handcrafted using the ancestral method of grinding rock salt alongside organic local ingredients. This slow stone-milling process preserves the organic essential oils and authentic aromatic heritage of the Pahadi kitchen.

Key Highlights:

  • Hand-Crushed on Sil-Batta: Made using traditional stone grinding to retain essential oils.
  • Himalayan Herbs & Seeds: Blended with aromatic seeds like hemp (Bhaang), mountain chili, and native herbs.
  • Natural & Aromatic: No artificial flavors, preservatives, or anti-caking agents.
